headline: Senior Software Engineer | Cloud & Distributed Systems
profileSummary: Senior Software Engineer based in Melbourne with 9+ years of experience designing, building, and operating production systems. I focus on backend and platform engineering using AWS, TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS, and PostgreSQL, with full-stack experience in React and React Native.

I have led architecture decisions, built distributed and event-driven systems, and improved production reliability, API performance, and deployment speed. My experience includes healthcare, banking, and mobile device platforms, with access control and audit logging built into core workflows. I have full working rights in Australia and require no sponsorship.

projects.title: Document Management System
projects.description: Developed a secure, on-premises document management system for a banking client using React, Spring Boot, and MSSQL. Built a distributed OCR processing pipeline using Flask, Celery, RabbitMQ, and Tesseract, handling around 100,000 documents with role-based access controls and audit logging.

projects.title: Natural Language Query Platform
projects.description: Built APIs and React-based visualizations for an enterprise analytics platform that lets users query datasets using natural language. Developed context-based query suggestions, expanded supported query patterns, and optimized large datasets for responsive charts and efficient memory usage.

projects.title: Healthcare Practice Management Platform
projects.description: Built backend services and React-based interfaces for healthcare workflows, including patient records, appointment scheduling, and billing integrations. Implemented access controls and audit logging, integrated partner bank APIs, and automated SSL certificate generation and renewal, reducing manual configuration effort by approximately 80%.

projects.title: Pinwheel Parental Control Smartphone
projects.description: Built backend, web, and mobile features for a smartphone platform for children and teens. Implemented WebAuthn and biometric authentication, built a RabbitMQ-backed MQTT pipeline for device communication, and led a zero-downtime MongoDB migration that reduced API latency by approximately 55% (2.0 s to 0.9 s).

projects.title: Dolpin
projects.description: A decentralized and encrypted storage layer built with IPFS / Filecoin, enabling secure file sharing. Designed to back up valuable NFTs and digital assets with enhanced privacy and security.
